signals.detail: Claims of NIS 46 million; owners injecting zero new equity; formal debt arrangement (הסדר חוב) initiated.

chain.spread: Could affect suppliers of raw materials (plastic resins, cardboard, inks) and customers in food, retail, and industrial packaging.
